title: Senior DevOps Engineer | Edge Computing (all genders welcome)
description:
#### **Your Role**

**Freshly cooked food. Everywhere. All the time.**  

  

With our robots, we’re transforming the way the world cooks and enjoys food. Through technology that supports the foodservice industry, reduces food waste, and elevates culinary quality to a new, scalable level. Accessible to everyone. Everywhere. Anytime. We give our all to make this happen – across every level, team and function.  

  

As Senior DevOps Engineer, you make sure our robotic kitchens run reliably in the field. By automating edge\\-server provisioning and operations, strengthening our deployment and release pipelines, and enabling the software team with CI/CD and staging environments that let us ship fast, safely, and repeatably.  

  

**These are the tasks you will be responsible for:**

* **Edge infrastructure automation:** You automate provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle operations of the edge servers that run our robotic kitchens – so we can scale production deployments without friction.
* **Delivery pipeline engineering:** You own and evolve our deployment pipeline to ship customer\\-facing software updates to robots in the field fast, reliably, and with confidence.
* **Release operations \\& observability:** You run deployments end\\-to\\-end, monitor fleet health and key service metrics, and lead incident response (including safe rollbacks) when releases misbehave.
* **CI/CD platform support:** You empower our software teams with strong CI/CD foundations – especially by building and refining staging environments that realistically mirror the robotic edge setup and production behavior.

#### **Your profile**


You’re passionate about innovative technologies, excited about the role, and ready to help us revolutionize the worlds of tech and culinary even further? Let’s get cooking!  

  

**These are the qualities helping you thrive in this role:**

* **DevOps \\& SysAdmin foundation:** You have strong hands\\-on DevOps experience (ideally 5\\+ years) and a solid system administration background (Linux ops, troubleshooting, stability, basics in networking \\& hardening).
* **Linux on edge \\& robotics mindset:** You’re confident with Linux distributions and you enjoy working close to hardware in an edge/robotics environment.
* **IaC, containers \\& Kubernetes:** You’re proficient with Ansible and Helm, know Docker, and have practical experience with Kubernetes (or you can ramp up fast).
* **Hybrid infrastructure (not cloud\\-only):** You are confident running solutions across self\\-managed on\\-premise servers rather than only relying on cloud infrastructure.
* **Databases \\& coding:** Experience working with different types of databases as well as object\\-oriented programming experience (e.g., Python, C\\+\\+) to build automation and tooling are a plus.
* **Bare\\-metal Linux \\& on\\-site networking mindset**: You can take a device from “on the bench” to “production\\-ready”: install and harden Linux, troubleshoot drivers/storage, and bring up connectivity by configuring routers/switches (e.g., switchports, VLANs, DHCP/DNS, VPN).
* **Collaboration \\& languages:** You work seamlessly with cross\\-functional teams (Software, Robotics, Manufacturing, Operations), communicate clearly, and you’re fluent in English.
* **Problem\\-solving mindset:** You learn fast, love tackling new technical challenges, and you consistently push for the best solution.

#### **About us**

**At goodBytz, you're more than just part of a team – you'll be a key contributor who helps shape what we build.**  

  

We're looking for colleagues who don't just go along for the ride, but have the courage to speak up and share critical perspectives. Because respect, trust, and open dialogue are the foundation of our success and satisfaction.  

  

**What's waiting for you:**  

  

**goodBytz Culineers Canteen**  

Our demo robot felix keeps you fueled around the clock with fresh meals at a discounted employee rate.  

  

**Mental Health**  

Access to the mental health platform OpenUp, where you can book confidential 1:1 sessions with certified psychologists, health experts, and financial coaches – whenever you need them. Up to three family members also receive personalized access.  

  

**Bike Leasing**  

Your new ride is already waiting! After completing your probationary period, you can take advantage of our bike leasing program and pick the bike of your dreams.  

  

**Flexible Working Hours**  

Options to work remotely (where the role allows) and flexible scheduling to support a healthy work\\-life balance.  

  

**Team Events**  

From after\\-work BBQs to company runs to our Family \\& Friends Event: at goodBytz, we regularly create shared moments that bring our team together**.**  

  

**Your Personal Benefit – You Choose**  

At goodBytz, you know best what works for you. That's why you pick your own preferred benefit from the following options:

  

* Urban Sports Club membership subsidy
* Germany\\-wide transit subsidy (hvv Jobticket Premium)
* Edenred City Card

  

**Our mission**  

goodBytz develops intelligent cooking robots. These enable professional chefs to make their cooking qualitatively scalable and reproducible. At the same time, we provide culinary innovators from around the world with a comprehensive solution based on robots, AI and Big Data tools, enabling our society to produce and prepare food in a more sustainable way. At the same time, high quality, sustainable and delicious food will be made available to the masses. Our robotic kitchens are capable of performing all processes of cooking, starting from portioning ingredients to washing pots. The integrated sensor technology enables precise monitoring and control of the cooking processes, continuously achieving high quality.  

  

**Our values**  

At goodBytz, we want every team member to bring their passion, creativity, and individuality to work. With a high degree of autonomy and transparency across all areas of the business, everyone is empowered to make fast, independent decisions. We believe great teams are built from diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. At goodBytz, everyone is welcome – regardless of gender, gender identity, origin, nationality, religion, age, sexual orientation, or disability. If you need any individual adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know – we're happy to help. Join our mission and help us democratize healthy, sustainable, and delicious food.  

  

**Your new workplace is more than just a job – it's a chance to be part of something bigger. Become part of goodBytz and let's shape the future together!**
